claim_scope: Homogeneous independent-rate-one cyclic deposition; fixed real thresholds; Gaussian final-gap process in the countable product topology; independently limiting Gumbel last-root step.
integrity: Proof checked from explicit conditional survivor masks and local Poisson dependencies. Finite code checks supplement rather than establish infinite probability limits.
scientific_limitations: Marginal Gaussian gap limits and covariance constants are inputs from arXiv:2610.21094v1.
Conditional error shown for each fixed threshold, not uniformly in moving thresholds.
Homogeneous rates only; no growing gap-length joint theorem or quantitative Gaussian joint rate.
title: Conditional Gumbel decoupling from Gaussian root-gap fluctuations in cyclic ballistic deposition
